agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py: ReindentFilter._flatten_up_to_token had an inverted break condition (`if not (t == token): break` instead of `if t == token: break`), which caused the generator used by _get_offset to yield almost nothing, breaking indentation/offset calculations across reindent code paths (parenthesis, where, identifier list, values, case, etc.) — matching the reported 22 failing checks. Corrected the condition to `if t == token: break`. Verified via direct sqlparse.format(reindent=True) calls that nested-parenthesis and where/identifier-list reindentation now produce the expected, correctly indented output.
